args.request: Could you make an explainer about why we hear echoes? I remember wondering about that as a kid, so it feels like a fun thing to explain. What I have in mind is a 10-second vertical video with a voice-over, and I would like you to write the words yourself. Please keep the explanation easy for kids to understand. You can choose the look, since I don't have a particular visual style in mind.

story.title: Why We Hear Echoes
story.setting: A sunny rocky canyon with tall orange cliffs and blue sky, in a bright, colorful 3D cartoon style like a kids animated film.

subjects.words: A cheerful cartoon kid with curly brown hair, a yellow t-shirt and red sneakers

beats.text: The kid cups hands around mouth and shouts toward the far cliff; glowing blue rings of sound ripple out from the kid across the canyon.
says: When you shout, your voice zooms away as invisible sound waves.

beats.text: The glowing blue rings hit the tall cliff wall and bounce back toward the kid, who smiles in surprise and cups a hand to an ear.
says: They bounce off the hard cliff and come back to your ears. That is an echo!

story.narrator: a warm, friendly, playful voice, like a kids TV show host
story.music: light, playful, curious music with marimba and soft plucked strings
